findings.title: SQL built by string concatenation from req.query.name
findings.first_evidence: return db.raw("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'");
findings.why_it_matters: User input reaches the SQL text unescaped.

findings.title: Migration drops orders.legacy_note without a backfill or down path
findings.suggested_fix: Copy data first or add a reversible down migration.
findings.why_it_matters: Irreversible column drop loses stored data.

findings.title: warm() has a check-then-set race under concurrent callers
findings.suggested_fix: Store the pending promise in the map before awaiting.
findings.why_it_matters: Two concurrent callers both run the loader; a slower loader overwrites a newer value.

findings.title: Live payment API secret hardcoded in config.js
findings.suggested_fix: Load from environment; rotate the key.

findings.title: getTok is an unclear name for a token accessor
retries: 3 has no backoff between attempts
findings.why_it_matters: Tight retries can amplify load on a struggling dependency.
